name: Tabs
description:
The Tabs component is used to create a tabbed interface. It organizes related content into panels that share the same space, showing one panel at a time while the tab list lets users switch between them.

Use `Tabs.ListGroup` for a tab list that renders the active tab indicator for you, or compose the primitives for full structural control. It supports different palettes, a vertical orientation, and placing the indicator at the start or end edge of the list.

parts.name: ListGroup
parts.description: An abstraction that renders the tab list with the active tab indicator

parts.name: Root
parts.description: The root container of the Tabs component.

props.name: palette
props.description: PandaCSS recipe variant for palette.

props.name: indicatorPlacement
props.description: PandaCSS recipe variant for indicatorPlacement.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the tabs. Useful for composition.

props.name: translations
props.description: Specifies the localized strings that identifies the accessibility elements and their states

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: Whether the keyboard navigation will loop from last tab to first, and vice versa.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled selected tab value

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial selected tab value when rendered. Use when you don't need to control the selected tab value.

props.name: orientation
props.description: The orientation of the tabs. Can be `horizontal` or `vertical` - `horizontal`: only left and right arrow key navigation will work. - `vertical`: only up and down arrow key navigation will work.

props.name: activationMode
props.description: The activation mode of the tabs. Can be `manual` or `automatic` - `manual`: Tabs are activated when clicked or press `enter` key. - `automatic`: Tabs are activated when receiving focus

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Callback to be called when the selected/active tab changes

props.name: onFocusChange
props.description: Callback to be called when the focused tab changes

props.name: composite
props.description: Whether the tab is composite

props.name: deselectable
props.description: Whether the active tab can be deselected when clicking on it.

props.name: navigate
props.description: Function to navigate to the selected tab when clicking on it. Useful if tab triggers are anchor elements.

props.name: lazyMount
props.description: Whether to enable lazy mounting

props.name: unmountOnExit
props.description: Whether to unmount on exit.

props.name: hideMode
props.description: How to hide content when mounted but not present. - `'display-none'`: HTML `hidden` attribute. Effects stay alive. - `'activity'`: React 19 `<Activity mode="hidden">`. Effects pause. Requires React 19+.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merges props and accessibility attributes onto the immediate child element instead of rendering a wrapper DOM node.

props.name: unstyled
props.description: Strips Cerberus PandaCSS recipe classes while preserving behavior and WAI-ARIA attributes.

props.name: css
props.description: PandaCSS style object for custom atomic styling. All PandaCSS style props (e.g. p, bg, color) are also accepted.

keyboard.description: When focus moves onto the tabs, focuses the active trigger. When a trigger is focused, moves focus to the active content.

Moves focus to the next trigger in horizontal orientation and activates its associated content.
Moves focus to the previous trigger in vertical orientation and activates its associated content.
Moves focus to the previous trigger in horizontal orientation and activates its associated content.
Moves focus to the first trigger and activates its associated content.
Moves focus to the last trigger and activates its associated content.
